title: Rava Laddu
description: Soft, coconut-studded semolina laddus bound with ghee and a little milk, a favourite for festivals and tea time.
steps: Heat 1 tbsp of the ghee and fry the cashews and raisins until golden; set aside.
Add 1 tbsp more ghee and roast the sooji on low heat for 8 to 10 minutes until fragrant and lightly coloured.
Add the grated coconut and roast 2 minutes more.
Transfer to a plate, cool slightly, and mix in the powdered sugar, cardamom, cashews and raisins.
Melt the remaining ghee and mix it in, then sprinkle the warm milk a little at a time until the mixture holds when pressed.
Shape into 12 laddus and let them firm up for 30 minutes before storing.
